_comment: One entry per club night, newest first. Written by the admin console (Post a night) or by hand. build/build_nights.py turns these into /nights/<date>/ pages, the archive, the RSS feed and the sitemap. 'line' is Harold's own sentence about the night; 'commentary' is the write-up of the numbers.

nights.title: Season 10 opens
nights.photo_alt: The first league night of season 10: three long tables of boards on the patio at Kava Social Club, sixteen players under the string lights
nights.photo_alt_es: La primera noche de liga de la temporada 10: tres mesas largas de tableros en el patio de Kava Social Club, dieciséis jugadores bajo las luces
nights.commentary: Season 10 opened with sixteen players across three brackets and five rounds. Scott went through the over-1400s untouched at 5–0, with Alex, Harold and Mathew a full two points back on 3. In the under-1400s Omar Cruz dropped only one game for 4 of 5, a point clear of Josh, while Zack, Brian O and Mel finished level on 2. The under-1000s were the tightest bracket of the night: Sonny and Maddie shared first on 2 points. Derek, Thomas, Diego and Sam left before the last round; their scores stand as played.
nights.commentary_es: La temporada 10 abrió con dieciséis jugadores en tres grupos y cinco rondas. Scott pasó por los más de 1400 sin perder, 5–0, con Alex, Harold y Mathew dos puntos atrás con 3. En los menos de 1400, Omar Cruz cedió una sola partida para sumar 4 de 5, un punto por delante de Josh, mientras Zack, Brian O y Mel terminaron empatados con 2. Los menos de 1000 fueron el grupo más apretado de la noche: Sonny y Maddie compartieron el primer puesto con 2 puntos. Derek, Thomas, Diego y Sam se fueron antes de la última ronda; sus puntajes quedan como se jugaron.
